subject: general
question: What was India’s rank in the Global Gender Gap Report, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**131st out of 148 nations**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India ranked **131st out of 148 countries** in the Global Gender Gap Report 2025, reflecting its position in gender parity globally.
 
• The report is published annually by the **World Economic Forum** (WEF) and measures gender-based gaps in economic participation, education, health, and political empowerment.
 
• India's performance showed progress in areas like **women's political empowerment**, where it has a relatively higher global ranking.
 
• However, India faced challenges in closing gaps in areas such as **economic participation and opportunity**, and health and survival metrics.
 
• The report provides a comprehensive ranking system to help countries identify areas for improvement in gender parity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Gender Gap Report:**

 
 
• Published by the World Economic Forum since 2006.
 
• It benchmarks gender parity across four key dimensions: Economic Participation, Educational Attainment, Health and Survival, and Political Empowerment.
 
• Uses a scoring system where 1 indicates full parity and 0 indicates disparity.
 
 
 
• **India's Gender Parity Challenges:**
 
 
• Women continue to face barriers in economic participation due to **low workforce representation** and unequal wage gaps.
 
• Health and survival metrics are impacted by issues like **gender-based violence** and access to healthcare.
 
 
 
• **Global Trends:**
 
 
• Iceland has consistently ranked as the most gender-equal country globally.
 
• The report estimates that it will take over **135 years** to achieve global gender parity.
 
 
 
• **India's Initiatives for Gender Equality:**
 
 
• Programs like **Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao** aim to improve the status of women and girls.
 
• Legislation such as the **Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act** seeks to provide economic security for working women.
 
• Several schemes like **Mahila E-Haat** and **STEP (Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women)** encourage women's empowerment and entrepreneurship.
